issues.description: Function name mismatch for the distillation circuit builder: the problem statement and solution expect a function named build_msd_circ(circ, distilled_state, y_states) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]], but the template repository defines build_msd_circuit(...) instead. This naming discrepancy is structural and will prevent students from matching the required API or running tests that expect build_msd_circ.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function build_msd_circuit to build_msd_circ and ensure its signature matches the problem statement (circ, distilled_state, y_states). Alternatively, add a thin wrapper in the template named build_msd_circ that calls build_msd_circuit, preserving the intended API so tests and student implementations align with the specification.

issues.description: The problem statement and the reference solution expect a function named build_msd_circ, but the template repository defines the same conceptual function as build_msd_circuit. This inconsistent identifier naming for the same core entity (the distillation circuit builder) can confuse students and cause tests or autograders that expect build_msd_circ to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the function in the template from build_msd_circuit to build_msd_circ to match the problem statement and solution (or alternatively, update the problem statement/tests to use build_msd_circuit). Ensure all references (tests and documentation) use the same identifier.
